tasks.label: Pynguin: generate tests (calculator)
args: $env:PYTHONPATH='src'; pynguin --project-path src --module-name simple_programs.calculator --output-path tests_generated --output-language pytest --algorithm MIO --maximum-search-time 120 --coverage-metric branch

tasks.label: Run tests + coverage
args: coverage run -m pytest tests_generated; coverage report -m; coverage html -d reports/coverage
